name: ink_dynasty
theme: a sumi-e ink cosmos — an empty moonlit calligraphy studio down through one brushstroke's feathering ink to the carbon lattice inside the soot, which becomes the hexagonal pole storm of a colossal ringed planet, then a fall down ink-wash mountains back to the studio

registers.name: studio
registers.palette: ink black, paper cream and cold moon silver
registers.scene: a moonlit calligraphy studio seen wide from the open doorway, empty, no one present, a long low lacquered table beneath a paper lattice window, bamboo-handled ink brushes racked in a row, a carved stone inkstone and a black ink stick beside them, a long silk scroll unrolled across the table with ink-wash ridges painted on its cream paper, one small square vermilion seal stamped bright at the scroll's edge, cold moonlight across the plank floor
registers.target: a long silk scroll unrolled flat, cream paper with black ink-wash ridges painted across it
registers.loop_target: the moonlit calligraphy studio seen wide from the open doorway, brushes and a stone inkstone beside a long unrolled scroll on the low lacquered table

registers.name: scroll
registers.scene: an unrolled silk scroll spread flat on a low lacquered table, cream paper grain everywhere, ink-wash ridges and pale mist bands brushed over it, a small square vermilion seal stamped at one corner
registers.target: a bold black brushstroke, a broad band of dense ink with a split dry-brush tail

registers.name: brushstroke
registers.scene: a single bold black brushstroke laid across a plain of cream paper, dense wet ink at its core, dry-brush streaks combed along its length, bare paper showing through the split tail
registers.target: a feathered ink edge, a fringe of fine black filaments

registers.name: ink_feathering
registers.palette: ink black and pale fiber cream
registers.scene: wet paper fiber country, a branching black thicket of ink fingers through a pale mesh of cream fibers, every finger split into finer and finer twigs down to hairline threads, small beads of ink caught in the weave
registers.target: a round black soot grain, a matte dark bead with a faint silver rim

registers.name: soot
registers.scene: a dark fluid realm packed with round carbon soot grains, matte black spheres in clumped chains, faint silver rim light on each, fine black dust between them
registers.target: a bright six-sided cell grid, glowing bonds drawn in white

registers.name: carbon_lattice
registers.palette: glowing white on black, warming toward pale cream
registers.scene: a flawless carbon lattice spread through the deep black, a grid of six-sided cells drawn in glowing white bonds, the grid repeating away on every side, one small bright atom at every node

registers.name: ringed_planet
registers.palette: ink black, cream rings and one vermilion star
registers.scene: a colossal ringed gas planet in a black ink-wash cosmos, broad rings of pale cream light past its curve, cloud bands brushed over it in sweeping washes of black and silver, pale star-mist washed across the void, one small vermilion star in the black
registers.target: a vast six-sided storm, six straight walls of ink-dark cloud around a dark eye

registers.name: pole_storm
registers.scene: an immense six-sided storm set in a plain of banded cloud, six straight walls of ink-dark cloud, silver-white vapor combed along every edge, a dark round eye at the center
registers.target: a dark round storm eye, an open well of still air

registers.name: river_gorge
registers.scene: a mountain river gorge in black ink wash seen from high above, layered peaks pale in silver mist, pine-crowned crags over a black river between the cliffs, a pale moon low behind the farthest ridge
registers.target: a small wooden pavilion, paper windows warm with lamplight and a curling tiled roof

registers.name: water_pavilion
registers.palette: warm lamp gold and ink black
registers.scene: a small wooden pavilion on stilts over black water, empty, no one present, paper lattice windows warm with lamplight, tiled roof curling at the eaves, pine branches and mist banks at its rail, an open doorway on the water side

music_theme: a moonlit ink-painting cosmos — sparse plucked strings and a low bamboo flute over deep resonant drones, hushed and vast, one struck bell landing on the lattice-to-storm seam and taiko weight through the storm before the quiet fall home
